_comment: Hand labels for corpus/real (third-party files). Each entry = a location a reviewer should be warned about. Files not listed have no expected findings. Fixtures in corpus/fixtures carry inline '// expect: PRCxxx' markers instead. Labelled by reading every line matching a broad superset grep (lookahead|security|calc_on_every_tick|varip|timenow|barstate.*|alert*|offset=-|label/line/box.new with past x) before comparing with tool output.

real/arun_liquidity_void_mtf.pine.note: HTF high/low/close/atr with lookahead_on, no [1]: genuine future leak

real/arun_magnetic_zones_mtf.pine.note: barstate.islast changes returned value on last bar
